en.reason: Now in preview in the Gemini API, Tool Retrieval lets agents use hundreds of tools while cutting input tokens and latency by loading parameter schemas on demand via tool_search with defer_loading: true.

sources.summary:
Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) 9 and RHEL 10 images for GitHub-hosted larger runners are now generally available. Originally introduced in public preview in June 2026 in partnership with Red…
Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) 9 and RHEL 10 images for GitHub-hosted larger runners are now generally available. Originally introduced in public preview in June 2026 in partnership with Red Hat, these images are now fully supported for production workflows in GitHub Actions.
You can use RHEL images to ru
sources.recommend_reason_zh: GitHub 托管 larger runners 的 RHEL 9 和 RHEL 10 镜像现已正式可用，这些镜像在 2026 年 6 月与 Red Hat 合作公开预览后转为生产支持，GitHub Team 和 GitHub Enterprise Cloud 用户可在 Actions 工作流中直接选用。

en.reason: GitHub-hosted larger runners now offer generally available RHEL 9 and RHEL 10 images, moved from a June 2026 public preview with Red Hat to full production support in GitHub Actions for Team and Enterprise Cloud users.

items.title: Walter Isaacson 谈 AI 时代的好奇心与创造力 / Walter Isaacson on curiosity and creativity in the AI age.

sources.title: Walter Isaacson 谈 AI 时代的好奇心与创造力 / Walter Isaacson on curiosity and creativity in the AI age.

sources.title_en: Walter Isaacson on curiosity and creativity in the AI age.
sources.title_original: Walter Isaacson on curiosity and creativity in the AI age.
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 在 Google 新一期《Dialogues on Technology and Society》中，Kent Walker 与 Walter Isaacson 借 Leonardo da Vinci、Benjamin Franklin、Ada Lovelace 的经历，讨论历史突破为何常是团队合作，以及信息唾手可得时 AI 时代的好奇心与人类判断力为何更关键。

en.reason: Walter Isaacson tells Google’s Kent Walker in Dialogues on Technology and Society that Leonardo da Vinci, Benjamin Franklin and Ada Lovelace show breakthroughs are often team efforts and curiosity plus human judgment matter more as AI makes information abundant.
